Name: Introducing Zia - New NPC Overriding Clint
Author: Lightofella
Description: This mod was created for one of my college classes final projects. Me and my team member worked on this mod for about three weeks. There are still a couple unfinished parts of the mod and probably some bugs I've missed while playtesting. I will continue to regularly update this mod as well as fix anything that y'all suggest! This mod contains all new dialogue, heart events, dates, spring dance, and a wedding for Zia. A couple of the late game heart events still need to be changed, but for the most part, majority of the heart events are done. I hope y'all enjoy this mod! Let me know what you think. <3

Downloads.Description: Make sure you have Content Patcher and SMAPI installed to play this mod!
